recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. Treat the FHIR-34232 implementation as an Extension Pack matter; any remaining concern about starter event codes or examples should be handled in HL7/fhir-extensions or the related deferred trackers, not by editing current core source.
issue_request: FHIR-34232 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core and asked to improve the relative-date extension by relaxing target path handling to full FHIRPath, explaining computable Reference plus path anchors versus user-meaningful codes, documenting negative/positive/zero offset semantics, adding examples and starter event codes, dropping relationship, updating offset wording, and renaming the extension.
initial_application: The applied source change is in HL7/fhir-extensions: PR #193 merged commit af8044eb312062732ee855353048b9c8fa00920b, which updates StructureDefinition-relative-date.xml to clarify targetPath, targetReference/targetCode usage, relationship deprecation, and offset semantics. The Jira application comment explicitly notes that relationship was deprecated rather than removed and that the name was not changed for backward compatibility.
additional_context: Current core source has no relative-date StructureDefinition; it only keeps extension-pack references and OID registry entries. Later related work created core RelativeTime (FHIR-41582), temporarily deprecated relative-date/cqf-relativeDateTime in the Extension Pack (FHIR-41598/FHIR-42948), and then un-deprecated relative-date until relative-time can be made buildable (FHIR-50027). FHIR-39327 remains Resolved - change required and defers examples, so it is context rather than a final applied core edit.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The audit commit records that the seed belongs to the Extension Pack/current extension-pack build scope and that reintroducing or duplicating the extension in core would be incorrect.

related_jiras.note: Earlier core issue reconciled cqf-relativeDateTime and relative-date before the extension definitions moved out of core.
Resolved - change required issue asks for relative-date examples and notes they were still deferred; it is not final Applied/Published core work for this seed.
Created the core RelativeTime datatype with overlapping contextPath, contextCode, and offset semantics.
Extension Pack decision to retire relative-date/cqf-relativeDateTime in favor of relative-time.
Extension Pack decision to deprecate cqf-relativeDateTime and define a relative-time extension.
Extension Pack follow-up un-deprecated relative-date until the relative-time extension can reference RelativeTime successfully.
